original_goal: Confirm sandbox-to-home-Raspberry-Pi route; enable remote access; send ESP32-C3 scheduled IR action event logs to Pi and prove physical PoC

sandbox_route_probe.deduction: Sandbox egress/network isolation prevents confirming Pi reachability. ECONNREFUSED from Pi destination alone cannot be classified as remote SSH server down.

pi_power_safety.status: CURRENT POWER SAFETY STOP recorded 2026-10-11, no clearance verified
pi_power_safety.evidence: get_throttled=0x50000, 24 historical undervoltage events in 10 minutes; supply capability 900mA reported
pi_power_safety.action: No live Pi service deployment or added Pi workload performed pending safety clearance.

implemented.esp_action_hook: src/main.cpp runAlarmClock emits alarm_before_tx, alarm_after_tx, alarm_persist_failed, alarm_signal_missing
implemented.transport: Private-LAN, 220-byte max JSON in single best-effort UDP datagram per event, PI source filter, fsync JSONL on receiver
implemented.scope: Action boundary only, no raw IR waveform, network secrets, continuous high-rate logs, SSH/OAuth on ESP32
implemented.security_limit: Private LAN allowlist is not cryptographic source authentication; do not expose UDP port to WAN.
implemented.operational_limit: No ACK, no ESP offline queue; lost datagrams during power/WiFi outage cannot be recovered.

acceptance.description: Code-level bounded event protocol and Pi receiver
On GitHub Linux CI, real UDP socket delivery into fsync JSONL
ESP32 firmware builds and respects partition margin
Sandbox reaches home Pi via authorized route
Pi has running listener, verified on Pi
Physical ESP32 sends event and Pi receives it
Pi logs persist over Pi reboot and failure/retry behavior covered

current_session_connection_probes.tested_path: ChatGPT GitHub connector -> Issue #11 -> Mac LaunchAgent Issue Worker -> local gateway

pi_probe.reason: Installed Issue Worker lacks PI_PROBE action despite Local Gateway capabilities listing pi_probe

current_session_connection_probes.deployment_blocker: Existing worker in detached HEAD, update path sync_pinned requires named managed branch; global BOOTSTRAP_RUN has reset --hard, do not use unsafe self-update path.

private_cloud_redesign.objective: Make alarm logs readable by ChatGPT without requiring a live Mac/SSH/GAS path at read time
private_cloud_redesign.security: HTTPS/auth on Pi, no cloud credential on ESP; sender LAN UDP only; scrub source_ip from cloud payload; private issue; Pi fine-grained PAT Issues R/W recommended
private_cloud_redesign.delivery: Local fsync spool and Pi cloud retry after offline; deterministic event_id for duplicate detection. UDP loss pre-Pi not recovered.

acceptance.name: GPT can read private event inbox
Pi uplink retries failed cloud attempts from persisted local log
Pi real on-LAN process running, cloud credential configured
Physical ESP alarm event stored on Pi and posted to Issue #19
